title: Live-review packets for PROP packages are always degraded (state.open_r null -> priced_options could_not_price): derive open R from the prop ticket fill + declared risk + a mark
note: Manager ask 20:33Z. SEEN: pkg-d8838f396234477c (trend_donchian_eth_4h, tradeify_1) packets at 18:01Z and 20:01Z both carry context_null:state.open_r and priced_options could_not_price, so the lanes re-derived open R by hand. CODE (read 20:36Z): scripts/ops/live_review_packet.py takes open_r/peak_r/giveback_r/bars_held only from position_telemetry (tel) or the /api/bot/positions r-block (lines ~1166-1176). Neither has prop rows: the prop executor, not the trader exit loop, runs prop positions (already recorded on LTR-ROUTINE-REVIEWERS-NO-ROWS 11-13). The packet already reads prop_tickets (line 118) and uses them only to say a package is open (open_package_ids). The data exists: src/runtime/conflicting_exposure.open_r computed +1.78R for the same package from entry, sl, mark and the declared risk_per_unit (#26078). FIX (Tier 1, tooling): for a package open only on prop accounts, build state from the filled prop ticket (fill price, side, qty), the declared initial risk (r_provenance.declared_initial_risk, the same source as conflicting_exposure), and a mark = the last closed candle the packet already fetches. Then open_r = (mark - fill)/risk signed by side; peak_r from candle extremes since the fill; bars_held from the fill time. Stamp provenance 'prop_ticket_mark' (ESTIMATED, not MEASURED) and keep the miss() note if any input is absent. Test: a fixture prop package with no telemetry row gets a non-null open_r and priced_options runs. Clears when the next prop packet (any due key) carries a numeric state.open_r and priced_options_state != could_not_price. 2026-11-15 (reviewer LIVE-REVIEW-20261115-0011, prop velotrade_1, pkg-48c5cfab364e430c, row at 34228030, call HOLD). PACKET DEFECTS, each 1/1: (1) account_bounds EMPTY for a prop package, so the firm drawdown distance is missing; this is money-relevant on prop, because the reviewer cannot see distance-to-floor. (2) mechanics could_not_look: the prop ticket status is emitted but there is no account row. (3) state.open_r context_null (this row's known gap). (4) features_at_review all null: bars_held, peak_r, giveback_r, r_to_stop, r_to_target. Not filed: 'REVIEWER-BRIEF.md missing' (it is on main; the dispatch pointed at the rows branch). 2026-11-15 ~01:00Z: open_r part built, PR #26164 (Tier 1 self-land). The packet derives an ESTIMATED state (prop_ticket_mark) from the filled ticket + declared risk + last closed bar. STILL OPEN on this row: (1) account_bounds empty for prop packages (firm drawdown distance); (2) mechanics could_not_look with no account row. Clears (open_r part) when the next prop packet carries a numeric state.open_r and priced_options_state != could_not_price. REGRESSION FOUND 2026-11-15 (manager ask): #26164 never ran in production. _package_view filtered out tickets with source=='order_package', but /api/bot/prop/tickets stamps that source on REAL tickets (90/100 rows). Result: view.tickets was always empty, so prop-only packets had no accounts and open_r null (LR-20261115T0401Z pkg-48c5cfab). Fix: PR #26199 (4b58c83e, Tier 1 self-land) filters on a null ticket_id/account_id. A live rebuild gives open_r -0.604 ESTIMATED, 2 prop accounts, mechanics match, priced. Observation to close: the next prop-only packet committed after the merge carries a non-null state.open_r with peak_provenance prop_ticket_mark. #26199 MERGED 04:24Z (Tier 1 self-land). The packet generator runs from the VM tree (git-sync ~5 min), so it should apply from the next wake. Still waiting for the closing observation: a prop-only packet committed after 04:30Z with non-null state.open_r (provenance prop_ticket_mark) and the prop accounts in account_bounds. [2026-11-15 08:22Z Manager 15a, from LIVE-REVIEW-20261115-0808-PROPETH] Two more prop-packet gaps: (1) account_bounds carries no DD distance, although /api/bot/prop/status rule_distance is now populated for tradeify_1 and velotrade_1 (2/2) and the daily-loss distance is still null (realized_today unreported); (2) open_r is estimated from the last closed 4h bar, up to 4 h stale, not the venue mark (1/1). Fold both into this row's packet fix.
